user.title: KSeF access
user.description: Connect to KSeF with a KSeF token of the company whose cost invoices you want to be notified about. Generate the token in the KSeF taxpayer app of the same environment, with the **InvoiceRead** permission only. The token is checked against KSeF before it is saved.

data_description.environment: Production for real invoices; TEST and DEMO are KSeF's environments for trying things out. A token works only in the environment where it was generated.
data_description.nip: The company that receives the invoices. 10 digits; spaces and dashes are ignored.
data_description.token: Stored in Home Assistant and sent only to KSeF, encrypted.

notification.title: Notification
notification.description: Choose the phone to notify and what each notification shows. Fields marked as coming from the invoice itself (due date, payment form, bank account, items) make the integration download the invoice, one extra request to KSeF per new invoice.

data_description.notify_service: A Home Assistant Companion app notify service (notify.mobile_app_…). You may type one that is not registered yet.
data_description.fields: At least one. Fields always appear in a fixed order.

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.description: How often to ask KSeF for new invoices. 15 minutes is the shortest interval KSeF's guidance for production use allows.

data_description.check_interval_min: Minutes between checks: 15 to 1440, in steps of 5.

reauth_confirm.title: New KSeF token
reauth_confirm.description: KSeF no longer accepts the token of {entry_title}. Generate a new KSeF token for the same company and environment, with the **InvoiceRead** permission, and enter it here. Invoices already notified will not be notified again.

data_description.token: Stored in Home Assistant and sent only to KSeF, encrypted.

error.invalid_nip: This is not a valid NIP: it must have 10 digits and a correct check digit.
error.invalid_token: KSeF rejected the token. It may be mistyped, revoked or inactive, generated in another KSeF environment, or generated for a different NIP.
error.no_permission: The token works but lacks the InvoiceRead permission. Generate a token with InvoiceRead.
error.account_blocked: KSeF refused access for this company or person (the context or the account is blocked). Check the account in the KSeF taxpayer app.
error.rate_limited: KSeF asked to slow down (too many requests). Try again in a few minutes.
error.cannot_connect: KSeF could not be reached or did not answer properly. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.no_fields: Select at least one invoice field.
error.invalid_notify_service: Not a phone notify service. Use a notify.mobile_app_… service, for example mobile_app_my_phone.
error.invalid_interval: The interval must be a whole number of minutes in steps of 5.

abort.already_configured: This company is already set up for this KSeF environment.
abort.reauth_successful: The new KSeF token works and has been saved.

metadata_requests_last_hour.name: Invoice list requests in the last hour

download_requests_last_hour.name: Invoice downloads in the last hour

disabled.message: Notifications are switched off. Turn them on to check KSeF.

halted.message: Checks are stopped until the KSeF access problem is fixed. See the repair or re-authentication notice.

too_soon.message: KSeF was checked less than 10 minutes ago. The next manual check is possible at {time}.

notify_service_missing.title: The phone for KSeF notifications is not reachable
notify_service_missing.description: {entry_title} could not send a notification through {service}: the service is missing or failed. New invoices are still recorded, but they are not sent again once the phone works. Check the Home Assistant Companion app on the phone, or choose another phone in the integration's options. This notice disappears after the next notification that is sent successfully.

account_blocked.title: KSeF refuses access for {entry_title}
account_blocked.description: KSeF answered that access for this company or person is blocked, so checks for {entry_title} have stopped. Check the account in the KSeF taxpayer app. When it is resolved, reload the integration entry to start checking again.
